items_all_raw.title: Older Raptor Lake CPUs are a ‘core part of the portfolio’ for years to come, says Intel — there’s been a ‘sudden inrush of demand’ for LGA 1700 chips due to DDR5 prices
items_all_raw.summary: Intel has seen a “sudden inrush” of demand for Raptor Lake CPUs, and it says they’ll remain a part of the company’s lineup for desktop builders “for years to come.”
items_all_raw.title_original: Older Raptor Lake CPUs are a ‘core part of the portfolio’ for years to come, says Intel — there’s been a ‘sudden inrush of demand’ for LGA 1700 chips due to DDR5 prices

items_all_raw.title_bilingual: Older Raptor Lake CPUs are a ‘core part of the portfolio’ for years to come, says Intel — there’s been a ‘sudden inrush of demand’ for LGA 1700 chips due to DDR5 prices
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 英特尔已经看到了对 Raptor Lake CPU 的需求“突然涌入”，并表示“在未来几年”，它们仍将是该公司面向台式机制造商的产品阵容的一部分。
